findings.detail: The replacement mandatory-lane family V17-A4-P1-WKNDLIQ is DEAD by its own frozen falsification rule (3) when that rule's frozen series is actually measured, and the committed D2 novelty artifact for it was measured on a DIFFERENT series than the frozen one: measure_novelty_panel.py expo_wkndliq (lines ~104-112) implements the Sat/Sun arm of the frozen exposure_series_spec as r["day_utc"] in ("Saturday", "Sunday") - a comparison of a YYYY-MM-DD date string against weekday NAMES that can never be True (day_utc is validated elsewhere as a date string), so the measured series is the Friday hour>=22 flag ONLY, not the frozen full-weekend arc that the proposal pins verbatim ("e_t = -1 if (Friday AND hour>=22) OR day in {Saturday, Sunday}"; 'the exact signed calendar-flag series the anchor book holds'). Proof by reproduction: (a) with the Friday-only series the auditor reproduces ALL 11 committed daily rhos of d2_novelty_panel_v17.json V17-A4-P1-WKNDLIQ to <1e-9 (the committed artifact provably measured the divergent series, and its method note 'exposure per frozen proposal spec' is false as committed for this family); (b) with the FROZEN spec series - re-run through the cycle's OWN module with only that one clause fixed - the measured pooled |rho| are: 0.562799 vs daily:dvol_level_log, 0.556816 vs daily:dvol_shock, 0.343023 vs daily:elite (3 proxies over the 0.20 veto line; an independently written implementation agrees to <1e-9). The proposal's own falsification_rule item (3) (G12: 'pooled |rho| > 0.20 between the exposure_series_spec series and ANY forbidden-inventory conditioning exposure, measured at D2') therefore fires: VETO_MEASURED -> the family DIES at D2, mechanically, never argued away (frozen rubric binding_constraints.veto; same class as the V16 D2 pre-selection vetoes and as the F1 SILRES kill that refused audit v1). The family entered selection v2 and CODE_FREEZE_V2 on a NOVELTY_PASS (worst 0.1621) that does not measure its own frozen series. Additionally, the fail-closed remediation wired ONLY rule (4) (weekend coverage) into the driver; rule (3)'s owner is the D2 measurement itself, which measured a divergent series - so for the one rule that actually fires, the unowned/mismeasured-frozen-rule class the cycle just remediated recurs. A weekend calendar short correlating 0.56 with the activity-level forbidden family is exactly the confound G12 exists to catch; no disclosure, adjudication or artifact in the tree acknowledges the divergence or the spec-series veto

The thin_margins_register (selection_freeze_v17.json v1 AND the v2 re-freeze) again omits the worst measured novelty of the family actually SELECTED: WKNDLIQ's own committed panel-novelty number is 0.1621 vs daily:dvol_shock (margin 0.0379 under the 0.20 veto) - recorded in d2_novelty_panel_v17.json but absent from both register versions, while thinner (OICASCADE 0.0101) and comparable (SILRES 0.0384, added after the v1 audit's F6) margins were registered.
